 Order

This Court when made a query to the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Collector Land Acquisition as well as to Mr. Rohan Nanda, Sr. Panel Counsel, Union of India appearing for the Northern Railways, Udhampur as to how come the Collector Land Acquisition can be held entitled to maintain a statutory appeal against the land acquisition award passed by the reference court under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990, both counsel urged this Court to grant them one week's time for making submissions in response to this query.

sentences.text:
The present appeal is against an award dated 28.09.2013 passed by the Principal District Judge,
Reasi on file No. 11/Ref, whereby the land compensation came to be enhanced to be Rs.11,24,000/-
per kanal which is held payable in favour of the land owner-Satish Mahajan, whose legal representatives are now the respondent Nos. 1 & 2 in the present appeal.
03.
The appeal is time barred, as such, the condonation of delay application CONC No. 38/2016 is accompanying the said appeal.
04. List this case for consideration on 05.06.2024.
